# Global Alfabet

> Global Alfabet is a technology company that builds the Alfa family of digital products and offers design and development services to businesses in Africa and beyond. Tagline: Providing access.

## Products
- Alfa Maps: turns a property developer's layout plan and stand list into a 3D estate buyers explore on their phone, with house designs, prices, payment plans, PDF stand packs and WhatsApp enquiries. Demos available.
- Alfa Places (formerly BizDirect): a directory of businesses, attractions and places to visit. In development.
- Alfa Shop (formerly Global Alfabet Shop): an online marketplace for businesses and independent sellers. Coming soon.
- Global Alfabet Account: one sign-in for every Alfa product, with company workspaces. Coming soon.

## Services
UI/UX design, website development, digital product strategy.
